description: This file defines the DocumentsViewDetail class in a SuiteCRM module, extending the ViewDetail class. It customizes the display of document details, including a method for module title parameters and an override of the display method to handle missing files.

classes.name: DocumentsViewDetail
classes.description: A class for rendering the detailed view of document records in SuiteCRM, extending core view functionalities.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including the document name.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the document detail view, checking for missing files and displaying errors if needed.
